value.loc: Section 1 Introduction; Appendix G, p. not visible
value.quote: In our study we employ a quantitative approach.
value.note: Main results are quantitative proportionality guarantees/degrees (property satisfaction, treated as AX). Appendix G gives utilitarian efficiency guarantees (WD): 'Here, our goal is estimate the utilitarian efficiency of the considered'. LP computations are used to compute bounds, not outcomes, so not coded AL.

C1.reason: The Section 4 LPs (including the polynomial-time relaxed LP) are a technique for bounding the proportionality degree, a property of rules, not algorithms or complexity results for computing outcomes, so AL does not apply; the main results are proportionality guarantees (AX) with utilitarian efficiency in Appendix G (WD).
